text: Traveling to a new country is always an exciting experience. Before the trip, planning is important because you need to book flights, find a hotel, and decide what to see. When you arrive, everything feels different: the culture, the people, and the food. Trying local dishes is one of the best parts of traveling. However, language barriers can sometimes be a problem. You may not understand what people say, so you use gestures or simple words. Despite these challenges, travel creates wonderful memories that stay with you forever. Every trip teaches you something new about the world and about yourself.
